title: slugger: separators leak into slugs
summary: A slug library that produces doubled, leading, trailing and dangling separators.

issue.title: slugify() leaves doubled and dangling separators
issue.body:
Titles with extra spacing or punctuation produce ugly URLs.

slugify("hello --  world")
  got       hello----world
  expected  hello-world

slugify("  --Hi there--  ")
  got       --hi-there--
  expected  hi-there

slugify("a-b c", sep="_")
  got       a-b_c
  expected  a_b_c

slugify("hello world again", max_length=6)
  got       hello-
  expected  hello

A separator should never sit at either end of a slug, runs of separators should collapse into one, and hyphens in the input should become the chosen separator.
